title: How to Mail a Letter to Canada From Abroad
description: Two ways to get a letter to a Canadian address from another country: post it yourself with your own postage, or have it printed and mailed inside Canada.
keywords: mail a letter to canada from usa
send a letter to canada from uk
send a letter to canada from abroad
answer: From abroad you can post the letter yourself with your own country's international postage, or order it online and have a service print and mail it from inside Canada. Either way the address must follow Canadian format and end in a correct six-character postal code, because a missing or wrong code can raise the postage or leave the item undeliverable.

blocks.p: Canada Post's Lettermail delivery standards are estimates, not guarantees. Your own postal service sets its own timing for the part of the journey before the letter reaches Canada.

ul: Follow the Canadian order: addressee, street address, then municipality, province and postal code. [How to address a letter to Canada](/blog/how-to-address-a-letter-to-canada) shows each variant.
End with a valid postal code in the letter-number-letter, number-letter-number pattern: [Canadian postal code format](/blog/canadian-postal-code-format).
Add a return address in your own country, so the letter has somewhere to go back to.

blocks.p: Country-specific mistakes, such as writing the postal code like a ZIP code or putting the house number in the wrong place, are covered on the [mail to Canada pages](/mail-to-canada), one per country.
Whether it comes back depends on a valid return address. [Why letters to Canada get returned](/blog/why-letters-to-canada-get-returned) lists the reasons and a checklist.

sendletter takes the letter as a PDF, a Word file or typed text and mails it to a Canadian address. The return address can be typed as free text, so it can be outside Canada. [How online letter mailing works](/blog/how-online-letter-mailing-works) walks through each step.
